qualitative_acceptance: Visible material-detail improvement over v1; not hyperreal achieved.
final_observations: Basalt and lid show real mottling/grain compared with flat v1, but medium-scale cloudy variation still dominates microdetail.
Brass shading is more varied but remains slightly waxy; fine machining scratches are not strongly resolved at presentation scale.
Subdued mineral accent loses some legibility intentionally; no longer emissive.
Silhouette retained. Regular columns and uniform bevels still read stylized.
Open cavity depth readable. Mechanical straps added and included in sampled collisions, but lid still has a mild hovering impression.
Mobile emulator screenshot fits object and controls with no visible overflow; not physical-device testing.
Blender poster has useful soft ground contact; browser directional shadow remains comparatively hard.
polish_changes: Added connected lid-side hinge straps/rivets and extended fixed mount to barrel
Reduced environment brightness and softened shadow filtering
remaining_scope: Photographic fidelity would require a separate approved material/construction pass, not more verification claims.
